name: Tsuji Tokiko
source:
Age: 7 (at the time of her death)

One of the three main ghosts who roams Heavenly Host and the second victim of the murder case that took place in it. Her death was caused by repeated stabs with a pair of scissors above her jawline, which caused her decapitation, and the subsequent removal of her tongue. She kills her victims by beheading them, as shown by the many headless corpses that can be found in the school, and is usually accompanied by [url=/c11275]Yuki[/url].

[From the [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Tokiko_Tsuji?type=revision&diff=19799&oldid=17980]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
